guides.title: Emergency Water Purification Protocols
steps: 1. Silt Filtration: Filter flood water through clean folded cotton fabric (saree/dhoti).
2. Rolling Boil: Boil water vigorously for 3 minutes (5 minutes in mountains).
3. Chemical Disinfection: Add 2 drops of 5% unscented household bleach or 1 chlorine tablet per 1 liter; let stand 30 minutes.
4. SODIS: Expose filled clear PET bottles to direct intense sunlight on tin roof for 6 hours.

guides.title: Tactical First Aid & Severe Hemorrhage
steps: 1. Direct Pressure: Press clean cloth firmly on wound.
2. Tourniquet: For catastrophic limb bleeding, apply 2-3 inches above wound (not on joint). Note time on patient forehead.
3. Snakebite: DO NOT cut or suck venom. Immobilize limb at heart level with a splint. Transport immediately to hospital for ASV.
4. Hands-Only CPR: Push hard and fast at center of chest (100-120 bpm, 2 inches deep).

guides.title: Emergency Distress Signaling
steps: 1. Rule of Threes: 3 whistle blasts, 3 torch flashes, 3 smoke puffs.
3. Roof Ground Symbols for Aircraft: 'V' = Need Help, 'X' = Medical Urgent, 'II' = Need Food/Water.
